claims.text: Segmentation quality is evaluated by comparing automatic segmentations against a manually annotated reference corpus, such as the Annodis corpus.
An evaluation protocol was established to measure the performance of segmenters, focusing on metrics like F-score and recall.
The evaluation involves analyzing word pairs that represent segment borders to assess the accuracy of the segmentation.
